scope: Three genuinely distinct replacement models for existing evolution IDs. Game stats, family keys, owned specimens and dex numbers are unchanged. These are game evolutions, not biological life cycles.

models.name: GardenAntAdult
models.author: mujtaba-io
models.changes: Blender GLB conversion. Author bite clip also exposed as attack; a static idle uses the first walk pose. Original mesh and skeletal walk retained.

models.name: EmeraldMantisAdult
models.author: Linus via Gobkit Community
models.changes: Author idle and attack retained. Author move clip also exposed as walk. 2026-10-29: bone-white blade/spur materials tinted emerald/olive via baseColorFactor (recolor_emerald_mantis_blades.py); geometry and clips unchanged.

models.name: MonarchButterflyAdult
models.author: Cestmir Dammer / TinyWorlds; source photo documentation by Rick Hoppmann
models.changes: Blender GLB conversion; legacy diffuse/alpha image rebuilt as embedded Principled texture. Author Flying exposed as fly/walk; static idle uses first Flying pose. Original rig and wing animation retained.
